title: UK bride dances with hospitalised dad: she brings wedding to his ward; staff help arrange the dance
summary_full: Sinead Jackson's wedding was uniquely touched by bittersweet circumstances as her father, Leslie Healy, was hospitalized only days before the event. Hospital personnel facilitated a heartwarming moment, allowing Sinead to don her wedding dress for a dance with her father. Though Leslie couldn't physically attend, technology enabled him to witness the ceremony.
